hook.text: Over 60% of calories in American diets come from ultra-processed food. Your ancestors ate zero percent.

buildup.text: Ultra-processed means industrially formulated from extracted substances: oils, starches, sugars, additives.

discovery.text: Clinical trials show people eat 500 more calories per day on ultra-processed diets without realizing it.

twist.text: These foods bypass satiety signals evolution built for whole foods. Our hunger cues can't read the label.

climax.text: The mismatch between ancient hunger regulation and modern food engineering drives a global obesity epidemic.

punchline.text: Our brains can't count calories they didn't evolve to see.

quiz.question: Why do ultra-processed foods cause overeating?
options: They taste bad so people eat more to compensate
They bypass the satiety signals evolved for whole foods
